mentions.name: Integrated task/knowledge/publication system
mentions.description: An integrated system combining task management, knowledge, and publication, being rebuilt from a previous implementation built atop Gemini's Gemtext format to use the more fully featured Djot document format.
mentions.problem: The previous Gemtext-based design had lots of burrs, especially on the publication side, which a more fully featured document format like Djot can lift.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also rebuilding an integrated task/knowledge/publication system I'd previously built atop Gemini's Gemtext format. While I loved the simplicity, I've discovered that there are lots of burrs in that design, especially on the publication side, which I'd be able to lift by using a more fully featured document format like Djot.
